# nbo-png-authentication-keycloak-front

Código fuente de producción y configuraciones. Captura local: 28/10/2026.

Paquete: login. Se incluyen 103 archivos: 77 de TypeScript/JavaScript y 26 de estilos, recursos de texto, documentación y configuración.

Cada sección identifica la ruta original y conserva su contenido completo, salvo credenciales literales ocultadas en configuraciones. El código TypeScript/JavaScript se conserva sin cambios. Incluye componentes, páginas, hooks, servicios, tipos, rutas, estado, estilos, SVG, package.json, configuración de compilación y despliegue disponible.

Se excluyen tests y su configuración, dependencias instaladas, lockfiles, salidas generadas, cachés, metadatos de Git, instrucciones de agentes y recursos binarios. Los datos mock ubicados en el código de producción se conservan porque pueden ser consumidos por la aplicación.

Valores de credenciales ocultados: 0. Referencias a variables de entorno conservadas.

## Módulos

- auth

```yaml
      manifest_path_qa: overlays/testing-qa/apps/authentication-front
      manifest_path_preprod: overlays/release/apps/authentication-front
      repository_xac: nuamx/nbo-png-infraestructure-flux
```

## README.md

````markdown

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react/README.md) uses [Babel](https://babeljs.io/) for Fast Refresh
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/) for Fast Refresh

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type aware lint rules:

- Configure the top-level `parserOptions` property like this:

```js
export default tseslint.config({
  languageOptions: {
    // other options...
    parserOptions: {
      project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
      tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname
    }
  }
})
```

- Replace `tseslint.configs.recommended` to `tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked` or `tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked`
- Optionally add `...tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked`
- Install [eslint-plugin-react](https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react) and update the config:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import react from 'eslint-plugin-react'

export default tseslint.config({
  // Set the react version
  settings: { react: { version: '18.3' } },
  plugins: {
    // Add the react plugin
    react
  },
  rules: {
    // other rules...
    // Enable its recommended rules
    ...react.configs.recommended.rules,
    ...react.configs['jsx-runtime'].rules
  }
})
```

````

## nginx/default.conf.template

```
server {
    listen       80;
    listen  [::]:80;
    server_name  localhost;

    #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

    # ====================================
    # COMPRESIÓN GZIP
    # ====================================
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_types
        text/plain
        text/css
        text/xml
        text/javascript
        application/json
        application/javascript
        application/x-javascript
        application/xml
        application/xml+rss
        application/xhtml+xml
        application/x-font-ttf
        application/x-font-opentype
        application/vnd.ms-fontobject
        image/svg+xml;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_disable "msie6";

    # ====================================
    # ARCHIVOS ESTÁTICOS CON HASH (assets/)
    # Cache agresivo (1 año)
    # ====================================
    location /assets/ {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";

        # CORS (si es necesario para Module Federation)
        # add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, OPTIONS' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type' always;

        # Si el archivo no existe, retorna 404 (no redirigir a index.html)
        try_files $uri =404;        
    }

    # ====================================
    # index.html y remoteEntry.js
    # NO cachear (deben validarse siempre)
    # ====================================
    location = /index.html {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        add_header Pragma "no-cache";
        add_header Expires "0";

        # CORS
        # add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
    }

    location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        
        # Cache corto para remoteEntry (5 minutos)
        # Permite actualizaciones rápidas pero evita descargas constantes
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=300, must-revalidate";
        
        # CORS (CRÍTICO para Module Federation)
        # add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, OPTIONS' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type' always;
    }

    location / {
        root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index  index.html index.htm;
    }

    error_page  404              /404.html;

    # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
    #
    error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
    location = /50x.html {
        root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
    }

    # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
    #
    #location ~ \.php$ {
    #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
    #}

    # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
    #
    #location ~ \.php$ {
    #    root           html;
    #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
    #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
    #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
    #    include        fastcgi_params;
    #}

    # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
    # concurs with nginx's one
    #
    #location ~ /\.ht {
    #    deny  all;
    #}
}
```

## src/App.tsx

```tsx
import {
  PublicClientApplication,
  EventType,
  EventMessage,
  AccountInfo,
  AuthenticationResult
} from '@azure/msal-browser'
import { MsalProvider } from '@azure/msal-react'

import { msalConfig } from './shared/constants/azure'
import AppRouter from './shared/routes/AppRouter'

const msalInstance = new PublicClientApplication(msalConfig)

if (
  !msalInstance.getActiveAccount() &&
  msalInstance.getAllAccounts().length > 0
) {
  msalInstance.setActiveAccount(msalInstance.getAllAccounts()[0])
}

msalInstance.addEventCallback((event: EventMessage) => {
  if (
    (event.eventType === EventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS ||
      event.eventType === EventType.ACQUIRE_TOKEN_SUCCESS ||
      event.eventType === EventType.SSO_SILENT_SUCCESS) &&
    event.payload &&
    (event.payload as AuthenticationResult).account
  ) {
    const account = (event.payload as AuthenticationResult).account
    msalInstance.setActiveAccount(account as AccountInfo)
  }
})

function App() {
  return (
    <MsalProvider instance={msalInstance}>
      <div className="main-container">
        <AppRouter />
      </div>
    </MsalProvider>
  )
}

export default App

```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useAuthActions.ts

```typescript
import { type NavigateFunction } from 'react-router-dom'

import { ERROR_MESSAGES, HTTP_CODES, LOCAL_KEYS } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import { type LocalStorageProps } from '@/shared/types/LocalStorageProps'
import getFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/getFromLocalStorage'
import setFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/setFromLocalStorage'

import { useAuthService } from './useAuthService'
import { useAuthState } from './useAuthState'

export const useAuthActions = () => {
  const {
    setLoading,
    setForgotPassword,
    setError,
    setMessageError,
    setInfoUser,
    setInfoUserNubo,
    setToken,
    setUsername,
    setLoggedIn,
    setBlocked
  } = useAuthState()

  const {
    getToken,
    getUserNuboInfo,
    getKeycloakUser,
    updateUserPassword,
    resetUserBlocked,
    logoutUser,
    generateResetLog
  } = useAuthService()

  const {
    AUTHENTICATION: {
      subRoutes: { LOGIN }
    }
  } = ROUTES

  const reviewUser = async (navigate: NavigateFunction, email?: string) => {
    const userEmail =
      email ||
      getFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.USERNAME as LocalStorageProps) ||
      ''

    try {
      const { data: tokenRes } = await getToken()
      const token = tokenRes.access_token

      const { data: userNubo } = await getUserNuboInfo(userEmail, token)
      setInfoUserNubo(userNubo)

      const { data: kcUser } = await getKeycloakUser(userEmail, token)
      setInfoUser(kcUser)

      setUsername(userEmail)
      setToken(token)
      setLoggedIn(true)

      setFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.TOKEN, token)
      setFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.USERNAME, userEmail)
    } catch (error: any) {
      const status = error?.response?.status
      if (status === parseInt(HTTP_CODES.UNAUTHORIZED)) {
        setForgotPassword(true)
      } else {
        await logout()
        navigate(LOGIN.path)
      }
    }
  }

  const logout = async () => {
    const user =
      getFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.USERNAME as LocalStorageProps) || ''
    const token =
      getFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.TOKEN as LocalStorageProps) || ''
    await logoutUser(user, token)
    setFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.LOGOUT, Date.now().toString())
  }

  const resetFailedLogin = async () => {
    const user =
      getFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.USERNAME as LocalStorageProps) || ''
    const token =
      getFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.TOKEN as LocalStorageProps) || ''

    try {
      setLoading(true)
      const { data } = await resetUserBlocked(user, token)
      await generateResetLog(user, data)
    } catch (error: any) {
      const httpCode = error?.response?.data?.httpCode
      if (httpCode >= parseInt(HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR)) {
        setMessageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.SERVER_ERROR)
        setError(true)
      }
    } finally {
      setBlocked(false)
      setError(false)
      setMessageError(null)
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return {
    reviewUser,
    logout,
    resetFailedLogin,
    updateUserPassword
  }
}

```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useAuthService.ts

```typescript
import { httpUserManagment } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import {
  ERROR_MESSAGES,
  HEADERS_KEYS,
  API_HEADERS,
  RESPONSE_TYPES
} from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { API_ROUTES } from '@/shared/constants/endpoints'
import { buildStandardHeaders } from '@/shared/utils/headerServices'

import { getUserNuboInfo } from '../services/auth'
import { useEncryptPassword } from './useEncryptPassword'

export const useAuthService = () => {
  const { encodeData } = useEncryptPassword()

  const updateUserPassword = async (
    newPassword: string,
    userId: string,
    username: string,
    token: string
  ) => {
    const encrypted = encodeData(newPassword)

    try {
      await httpUserManagment.put(
        API_ROUTES.RESET_PASSWORD(userId),
        {
          type: 'password',
          value: encrypted,
          temporary: false
        },
        { headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token) }
      )
      return RESPONSE_TYPES.SUCCESS
    } catch (error: any) {
      const match = error?.response?.data?.errorMessageDetail?.match(
        /"error_description":"(.*?)"/
      )
      if (match?.[1] === ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_PASSWORD)
        return RESPONSE_TYPES.INVALID
      return RESPONSE_TYPES.ERROR
    }
  }

  const resetUserBlocked = async (username: string, token: string) => {
    return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.RESET_BLOCKED(username), null, {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
    })
  }

  const getToken = async () => {
    const { default: getCurrentDateTime } = await import(
      '@/shared/utils/getCurrentDateTime'
    )

    return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.GET_TOKEN, null, {
      headers: {
        [HEADERS_KEYS.DATE]: getCurrentDateTime(),
        grant_type: API_HEADERS.GRANT_TYPE
      }
    })
  }

  const getKeycloakUser = (username: string, token: string) => {
    return httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.GET_KEYCLOAK_USER(username), {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
    })
  }

  const logoutUser = async (username: string, token: string) => {
    await httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.LOGOUT(username), null, {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
    })
  }

  const generateResetLog = async (userName: string, data: any) => {
    const { id, status, participant } = data
    const { id: participantId, country } = participant

    await GenerateLogs(userName, {
      actionType: 'Reinicio de bloqueo de usuario',
      actionDestination: 'Homepage',
      participantId,
      countryId: country.id,
      userNuboId: id,
      statusId: status.id
    })
  }

  return {
    updateUserPassword,
    resetUserBlocked,
    logoutUser,
    getToken,
    getUserNuboInfo,
    getKeycloakUser,
    generateResetLog
  }
}

```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useAuthSlice.ts

```typescript
import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { NavigateFunction } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  onEmail,
  onAuthMicrosoft,
  onEmailRecovery,
  onError,
  onFirstLogin,
  onInfoUserNubo,
  onForgotPassword,
  onHasOTP,
  onInfoUser,
  onLoading,
  onLoggedIn,
  onMessageError,
  onPassword,
  onRecaptcha,
  onTokenUser,
  onUpdatePassword,
  onUsername,
  onBlocked,
  onSessionStartTime,
  resetAuth
} from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import * as AuthService from '@/features/auth/services/auth'
import { ErrorResponse } from '@/features/auth/types/errors'

import {
  API_HEADERS,
  HTTP_CODES,
  RESPONSE_TYPES
} from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import isDevMode from '@/shared/utils/isDevMode'
import getFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/getFromLocalStorage'
import setFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/setFromLocalStorage'

import { useEncryptPassword } from './useEncryptPassword'

const {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { LOGIN }
  }
} = ROUTES

export const useAuthSlice = () => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()

  const {
    email,
    username,
    password,
    firstLogin,
    isLoggedIn,
    emailRecovery,
    forgotPassword,
    token,
    error,
    messageError,
    loading,
    user,
    recaptcha,
    infoUser,
    infoUserNubo,
    hasOTP,
    updatePassword,
    isBlocked,
    authMicrosoft
  } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)

  const { encodeData } = useEncryptPassword()

  const tokenStorage = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN)

  const setEmail = (value: string) => {
    dispatch(onEmail(value))
  }
  const setUsername = (value: string) => {
    dispatch(onUsername(value))
  }
  const setPassword = (value: string) => {
    dispatch(onPassword(value))
  }
  const setEmailRecovery = (value: string) => {
    dispatch(onEmailRecovery(value))
  }

  const setFirstLogin = (payload: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onFirstLogin(payload))
  }

  const setForgotPassword = (payload: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onForgotPassword(payload))
  }
  const setTokenUser = (payload: string) => {
    dispatch(onTokenUser(payload))
  }
  const setBlocked = (payload: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onBlocked(payload))
  }
  const setAuthMicrosoft = (payload: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onAuthMicrosoft(payload))
  }

  const setNewPassword = async (newPassword: string, id: string) => {
    const cryptPassword = encodeData(newPassword)

    try {
      setLoading(true)
      await AuthService.resetPassword(
        id,
        cryptPassword,
        username,
        tokenStorage ?? token
      )

      return RESPONSE_TYPES.SUCCESS
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse

      const match = err?.response?.data?.errorMessageDetail.match(
        /"error_description":"(.*?)"/
      )
      if (
        match[1] ===
        'Invalid password: must not be equal to any of last 5 passwords.'
      ) {
        return RESPONSE_TYPES.INVALID
      } else {
        return RESPONSE_TYPES.ERROR
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const setResetFailed = async () => {
    const userName = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME) ?? ''

    try {
      setLoading(true)
      const { data } = await AuthService.resetUserBlocked(
        userName,
        tokenStorage ?? token
      )

      const { id, status, participant } = data
      const { id: participantId, country } = participant

      await GenerateLogs(userName, {
        actionType: `Reinicio de bloqueo de usuario`,
        actionDestination: 'Homepage',
        participantId,
        countryId: country.id,
        userNuboId: id,
        statusId: status.id
      })
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse
      if (err?.response?.data?.httpCode! >= HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR) {
        dispatch(
          onMessageError(
            'Error del servidor, por favor intente nuevamente más tarde.'
          )
        )
        dispatch(onError(true))
      }
    } finally {
      dispatch(onBlocked(false))
      dispatch(onError(false))
      dispatch(onMessageError(null))
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const setError = (state: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onError(state))
  }
  const setMessageError = (message: string) => {
    dispatch(onMessageError(message))
  }

  const setLoading = (state: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onLoading(state))
  }

  const setRecaptcha = (state: string | null) => {
    if (state) {
      dispatch(onRecaptcha(true))
    } else {
      dispatch(onRecaptcha(false))
    }
  }
  const setLoggedIn = (state: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onLoggedIn(state))
  }
  const setHasOTP = (state: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onHasOTP(state))
  }
  const setUpdatePassword = (state: boolean) => {
    dispatch(onUpdatePassword(state))
  }
  const setInfoUser = (state: any) => {
    dispatch(onInfoUser(state))
  }
  const setInfoUserNubo = (state: any) => {
    dispatch(onInfoUser(state))
  }
  const setSessionStartTime = (state: string) => {
    dispatch(onSessionStartTime(state))
  }

  const logoutUser = async (payload?: string) => {
    try {
      const userName = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME) ?? ''
      const token = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN) ?? ''
      await AuthService.logoutUser(userName, token)
    } catch {
      if (isDevMode()) {
        console.error('Error during logout request')
      }
    }

    dispatch(resetAuth())
    if (payload === STORAGE_KEYS.LOGOUT) {
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.LOGOUT, Date.now().toString())
    }
  }

  const reviewUser = async ({
    navigate,
    email
  }: {
    navigate: NavigateFunction
    email: string
  }) => {
    setFirstLogin(true)

    try {
      const validateEmail = email
        ? email
        : (getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME) ?? '')

      const { data } = await AuthService.getTokenClientByGrantType(
        API_HEADERS.GRANT_TYPE
      )

      const { access_token: token } = data

      const responseInfoUserNubo = await AuthService.getUserNuboInfo(
        validateEmail,
        token
      )

      const {
        id: idNubo,
        userName,
        userType,
        failedAttempt,
        blocked,
        status,
        otp,
        participant,
        participants,
        profiles,
        firstName,
        lastName,
        participantAfp,
        participantSponsors,
        profile,
        lastModifyDate
      } = responseInfoUserNubo?.data

      const { name: profileName, id: profileId } = profile
      const {
        name,
        id: participantId,
        country,
        type: participantType,
        documentNumber,
        code
      } = participant
      dispatch(
        onInfoUserNubo({
          id: idNubo,
          userName,
          userType,
          failedAttempt,
          isBlocked: blocked,
          status,
          isOtp: otp,
          profiles,
          participantSponsors,
          participantType,
          participantAfp,
          participants,
          name,
          firstName,
          lastName,
          participantId,
          country,
          profileName,
          profileId,
          documentNumber,
          code,
          lastModifyDate
        })
      )

      const response = await AuthService.fetchKeycloakUser(validateEmail, token)

      if (!token || !validateEmail) return
      setUsername(validateEmail!)
      setTokenUser(token)
      setInfoUser(response.data)
      setLoggedIn(true)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN, token)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME, validateEmail!)
    } catch (error: any) {
      const { response } = error
      if (response?.status === 401) {
        setForgotPassword(true)
      } else {
        logoutUser()
        navigate(LOGIN.path)
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    email,
    username,
    password,
    emailRecovery,
    firstLogin,
    isLoggedIn,
    forgotPassword,
    token,
    error,
    messageError,
    loading,
    user,
    recaptcha,
    infoUser,
    infoUserNubo,
    hasOTP,
    updatePassword,
    isBlocked,
    authMicrosoft,
    setEmail,
    setUsername,
    setPassword,
    setEmailRecovery,
    setError,
    setFirstLogin,
    setForgotPassword,
    setMessageError,
    setLoading,
    setRecaptcha,
    setLoggedIn,
    setNewPassword,
    setHasOTP,
    setUpdatePassword,
    logoutUser,
    setTokenUser,
    setInfoUser,
    setInfoUserNubo,
    setBlocked,
    setAuthMicrosoft,
    reviewUser,
    setResetFailed,
    setSessionStartTime
  }
}

```

```typescript
import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux'

import {
  onEmail,
  onUsername,
  onPassword,
  onEmailRecovery,
  onFirstLogin,
  onForgotPassword,
  onTokenUser,
  onError,
  onMessageError,
  onLoading,
  onRecaptcha,
  onLoggedIn,
  onHasOTP,
  onUpdatePassword,
  onInfoUser,
  onInfoUserNubo,
  onBlocked,
  onAuthMicrosoft,
  onSessionStartTime
} from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

export const useAuthState = () => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const auth = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)

  return {
    ...auth,
    setEmail: (email: string) => dispatch(onEmail(email)),
    setUsername: (username: string) => dispatch(onUsername(username)),
    setPassword: (password: string) => dispatch(onPassword(password)),
    setEmailRecovery: (email: string) => dispatch(onEmailRecovery(email)),
    setFirstLogin: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onFirstLogin(value)),
    setForgotPassword: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onForgotPassword(value)),
    setToken: (token: string) => dispatch(onTokenUser(token)),
    setError: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onError(value)),
    setMessageError: (message: string | null) =>
      dispatch(onMessageError(message)),
    setLoading: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onLoading(value)),
    setRecaptcha: (token: string | null) => dispatch(onRecaptcha(!!token)),
    setLoggedIn: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onLoggedIn(value)),
    setHasOTP: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onHasOTP(value)),
    setUpdatePassword: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onUpdatePassword(value)),
    setInfoUser: (value: any) => dispatch(onInfoUser(value)),
    setInfoUserNubo: (value: any) => dispatch(onInfoUserNubo(value)),
    setBlocked: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onBlocked(value)),
    setAuthMicrosoft: (value: boolean) => dispatch(onAuthMicrosoft(value)),
    setSessionStartTime: (value: string) => dispatch(onSessionStartTime(value))
  }
}
```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useDecryptPassword.ts

```typescript
import CryptoJS from 'crypto-js'

export const useDecryptPassword = () => {
  const generateSecretKey = (keyString: string) => {
    const keyBytes = CryptoJS.SHA256(keyString)
    return CryptoJS.enc.Hex.parse(keyBytes.toString().substring(0, 32))
  }

  const decodeData = (encoded: string) => {
    const key = generateSecretKey(import.meta.env.VITE_DECRYPTION_KEY)

    const ivAndEncryptedText = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.parse(encoded)

    const iv = CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.create(
      ivAndEncryptedText.words.slice(0, 4)
    )
    const encryptedText = CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.create(
      ivAndEncryptedText.words.slice(4)
    )
    const decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(
      // @ts-ignore
      { ciphertext: encryptedText },
      key,
      {
        iv,
        padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7,
        mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC
      }
    )

    const decoded = decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8)

    return decoded
  }

  return { decodeData }
}
```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useEncryptPassword.ts

```typescript
import CryptoJS from 'crypto-js'

export const useEncryptPassword = () => {
  const generateSecretKey = (keyString: string) => {
    const keyBytes = CryptoJS.SHA256(keyString)
    return CryptoJS.enc.Hex.parse(keyBytes.toString().substring(0, 32))
  }

  const encodeData = (password: string) => {
    const key = generateSecretKey(import.meta.env.VITE_DECRYPTION_KEY)

    const iv = CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.random(16)

    const encrypted = CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(password, key, {
      iv: iv,
      padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7,
      mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC
    })

    const ivAndEncryptedText = iv.concat(encrypted.ciphertext)

    const encoded = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(ivAndEncryptedText)

    return encoded
  }

  return { encodeData }
}
```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useLogin.ts

```typescript
import { useCallback } from 'react'
import validator from 'validator'

import {
  type ForgotPasswordParams,
  type UseLoginParams
} from '@/features/auth/types/login'

import {
  ERROR_MESSAGES_MICROSOFT,
  LOGIN_IDS,
  MICROSOFT_PROMPT_VALUES
} from '@/shared/constants/authMicrosoft'

import { useAuthSlice } from './useAuthSlice'
import { useTokenUser } from './useTokenUser'

export const useLogin = ({
  errorEmail,
  setErrorEmail,
  instance,
  setOpenModal,
  setInfoModal
}: UseLoginParams) => {
  const {
    email,
    password,
    emailRecovery,
    setEmail,
    setPassword,
    setError,
    setMessageError,
    setEmailRecovery
  } = useAuthSlice()

  const { setTokenUser, sendEmail } = useTokenUser()

  const identifyInput = (label: string, value: string) => {
    switch (label) {
      case LOGIN_IDS.email:
        setEmail(value)
        break
      case LOGIN_IDS.password:
        setPassword(value)
        break
      case LOGIN_IDS.recovery:
        setEmailRecovery(value)
        break
      default:
        break
    }
  }

  const isValidLogin = useCallback((): boolean => {
    return (
      validator.isEmail(email) && email.trim() !== '' && password.trim() !== ''
    )
  }, [email, password])

  const handlePress = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isValidLogin()) {
      setTokenUser({ setOpenModal, setInfoModal })
      setError(false)
    } else {
      setError(true)
      setMessageError(ERROR_MESSAGES_MICROSOFT.INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
    }
  }, [
    isValidLogin,
    setTokenUser,
    setError,
    setMessageError,
    setOpenModal,
    setInfoModal
  ])

  const handlePressMicrosoft = async () => {
    const { loginRequest } = await import('@/shared/constants/azure')
    instance
      .loginRedirect({
        ...loginRequest,
        prompt: MICROSOFT_PROMPT_VALUES.CREATE
      })
      .catch(async () => {
        const { default: isDevMode } = await import('@/shared/utils/isDevMode')
        if (isDevMode()) {
          console.log('Error al iniciar sesión con Microsoft')
        }
      })
  }

  const handleBlur = () => {
    const inputToValidate = email || emailRecovery
    if (!validator.isEmail(inputToValidate)) {
      setErrorEmail(ERROR_MESSAGES_MICROSOFT.INVALID_EMAIL)
    } else {
      setErrorEmail('')
    }
  }

  const handleClose = (params: ForgotPasswordParams) => {
    sendEmail(params)
  }

  return {
    errorEmail,
    identifyInput,
    handlePress,
    handlePressMicrosoft,
    handleBlur,
    handleClose
  }
}
```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useMicrosoftUser.ts

```typescript
import { type IPublicClientApplication } from '@azure/msal-browser'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { NavigateFunction } from 'react-router-dom'

import { fetchKeycloakUser, validateUser } from '@/features/auth/services/auth'
import { type ErrorResponse } from '@/features/auth/types/errors'
import { type InfoModal } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'

import { ERROR_CODES, ERROR_MESSAGES } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import setFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/setFromLocalStorage'

import { getMessageError } from '../utils/getMessageError'
import { useAuthSlice } from './useAuthSlice'

type TypeMicrosoft = {
  instance: IPublicClientApplication
  navigate: NavigateFunction
  setOpenModal?: (open: boolean) => void
  setInfoModal?: (info: InfoModal) => void
}

export const useMicrosoftUser = ({
  instance,
  navigate,
  setOpenModal,
  setInfoModal
}: TypeMicrosoft) => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const {
    setLoggedIn,
    setInfoUser,
    setTokenUser,
    setUsername,
    setError,
    setMessageError,
    setLoading
  } = useAuthSlice()

  const initializedRef = useRef(false)
  const activeAccount = instance.getActiveAccount()

  const {
    AUTHENTICATION: {
      subRoutes: { TWO_FA, CONFIG_TWO_FA }
    }
  } = ROUTES

  useEffect(() => {
    const loginMicrosoft = async () => {
      const { onError, onOtpIn, onMessageError, onInfoUserNubo } =
        await import('remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice')
      if (!activeAccount || initializedRef.current) return
      initializedRef.current = true
      const username = activeAccount.username

      try {
        const { fetchToken } = await import('../services/loginServices')
        setLoading(true)
        const { data } = await fetchToken(username)

        if (data?.previous_session && setOpenModal && setInfoModal) {
          setOpenModal(true)
          setInfoModal({
            title: ERROR_MESSAGES.SESSION_EXISTS,
            message: 'Por favor cierre esa sesión e intente de nuevo',
            textSuccess: 'Entendido',
            variant: 'warning',
            onClick: async () => {
              const { sendSessionEmail } =
                await import('../services/email-actions/sendSession')
              setOpenModal(false)
              await sendSessionEmail(username, data.access_token)
            }
          })
          sessionStorage.clear()
          return
        }

        setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN, data.access_token)
        setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME, username)
        setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.REFRESH_TOKEN, data.refresh_token)

        const { data: userInfo } = await validateUser(
          username,
          data.access_token
        )

        const { data: keycloakUser } = await fetchKeycloakUser(
          username,
          data.access_token
        )

        if (keycloakUser.length === 0) {
          setMessageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
          setError(true)
          return
        }

        const {
          id,
          userName,
          userType,
          failedAttempt,
          blocked,
          status,
          otp,
          participant,
          firstName,
          lastName,
          profile,
          identification,
          participantAfp,
          country,
          participants,
          profiles,
          participantSponsors,
          lastModifyDate
        } = userInfo

        dispatch(
          onInfoUserNubo({
            id,
            identification,
            userName,
            userType,
            failedAttempt,
            status,
            isOtp: otp,
            name: participant.name,
            firstName,
            lastName,
            participantSponsors,
            participantAfp,
            participantId: participant.id,
            participants,
            profiles,
            country,
            participantType: participant.type,
            countryParticipant: participant.country,
            profileName: profile.name,
            profileId: profile.id,
            documentNumber: participant.documentNumber,
            code: participant.code,
            lastModifyDate
          })
        )

        setInfoUser(keycloakUser[0])
        setUsername(username)
        setTokenUser(data.access_token)
        setLoggedIn(true)

        if (blocked) {
          dispatch(onMessageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED))
          dispatch(onError(true))
          return
        }

        dispatch(onOtpIn(true))
        navigate(otp ? TWO_FA.path : CONFIG_TWO_FA.path)
      } catch (error) {
        sessionStorage.clear()
        const apiError = error as ErrorResponse
        const { errorCode, httpCode } = apiError?.response?.data || {}

        const message = getMessageError({ errorCode, httpCode })
        if (errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS) {
          dispatch(
            onInfoUserNubo({
              isBlocked: true
            })
          )
        }

        if (message) {
          setMessageError(message)
          setError(true)
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }

    loginMicrosoft()
  }, [activeAccount])
}

```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useNewPassword.ts

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  onFirstLogin,
  onLoggedIn,
  onOtpIn
} from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import {
  NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES,
  PASSWORD_ACTIONS,
  PASSWORD_VALIDATION_INITIAL_STATE
} from '@/features/auth/constants/changePassword'
import { UseNewPasswordParams } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'
import { handlePasswordResponse } from '@/features/auth/utils/passwordHandlers'

import { RESPONSE_TYPES } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'

import { useAuthSlice } from './useAuthSlice'

export const useNewPassword = ({
  validation,
  newPassword,
  setValidation,
  setPassword,
  setOpenModal,
  setInfoModal
}: UseNewPasswordParams) => {
  const [passwordDone, setPasswordDone] = useState(false)
  const [passwordIqual, setPasswordIqual] = useState(false)
  const [hasFalseValue, setHasFalseValue] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  const {
    AUTHENTICATION: {
      subRoutes: { LOGIN, CONFIG_TWO_FA }
    }
  } = ROUTES

  const {
    setNewPassword,
    setLoggedIn,
    infoUserNubo,
    infoUser,
    username,
    setUpdatePassword,
    logoutUser
  } = useAuthSlice()

  useEffect(() => {
    setHasFalseValue(Object.values(validation).includes(false))
    setPasswordDone(!hasFalseValue && passwordIqual)
  }, [validation, passwordIqual, hasFalseValue])

  useEffect(() => {
    setValidation({ PASSWORD_VALIDATION_INITIAL_STATE })
  }, [newPassword])

  const handleInput = (_label: string, value: string) => {
    setPassword(value)
  }

  const confirmPassword = (_label: string, value: string) => {
    const matches = value === newPassword && value.length > 0
    setPasswordIqual(matches)
    setPasswordDone(matches && !hasFalseValue)
    if (!matches) setError('')
  }

  const handlePress = async (action: string) => {
    switch (action) {
      case PASSWORD_ACTIONS.CHANGE:
        if (infoUser.length === 0) return

        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOGGED_IN, 'true')
        dispatch(onLoggedIn(true))

        const response = await setNewPassword(newPassword, infoUser[0].id)

        const handleNavigation = () => {
          const queryParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
          const needsOtp = infoUserNubo.isOtp || queryParams.get('kpr')

          dispatch(onOtpIn(!needsOtp))
          dispatch(onFirstLogin(false))
          logoutUser()
          navigate(needsOtp ? LOGIN.path : CONFIG_TWO_FA.path)
        }

        const { id, status, participantId, country } = infoUserNubo
        if (response === RESPONSE_TYPES.SUCCESS) {
          await GenerateLogs(username, {
            actionType: 'Cambio de contraseña',
            actionDestination: 'Homepage',
            participantId,
            countryId: country.id,
            userNuboId: id,
            statusId: status.id
          })
        } else {
          await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 50))
        }

        handlePasswordResponse({
          response,
          setOpenModal,
          setInfoModal,
          setUpdatePassword,
          onSuccess: handleNavigation
        })
        break

      case PASSWORD_ACTIONS.BACK:
        setLoggedIn(false)
        dispatch(onFirstLogin(false))
        logoutUser()
        navigate(LOGIN.path)
        break
    }
  }

  const onBlur = () => {
    if (!passwordIqual) {
      setError(NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.PASSWORD_MISMATCH)
    }
  }

  return {
    error,
    passwordDone,
    handleInput,
    confirmPassword,
    handlePress,
    onBlur
  }
}

```

## src/features/auth/hooks/usePasswordValidation.ts

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { PASSWORD_RULES } from '@/features/auth/constants/changePassword'
import {
  hasMinLength,
  hasMinLowercase,
  hasMinNumbers,
  hasMinSpecialChars,
  hasMinUppercase,
  hasNoConsecutiveCharacters,
  hasNoSequentialCharacters
} from '@/features/auth/utils/passwordValidators'

export const usePasswordValidation = (input: string) => {
  const [validation, setValidation] = useState({
    minCharacters: false,
    minUppercase: false,
    minLowercase: false,
    minNumeric: false,
    minSpecialChar: false,
    noConsecutiveNoSequential: false
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (input.length >= 2) {
      setValidation({
        minCharacters: hasMinLength(input, PASSWORD_RULES.MIN_LENGTH),
        minUppercase: hasMinUppercase(input, PASSWORD_RULES.MIN_UPPERCASE),
        minLowercase: hasMinLowercase(input, PASSWORD_RULES.MIN_LOWERCASE),
        minNumeric: hasMinNumbers(input, PASSWORD_RULES.MIN_NUMERIC),
        minSpecialChar: hasMinSpecialChars(
          input,
          PASSWORD_RULES.MIN_SPECIAL_CHAR
        ),
        noConsecutiveNoSequential:
          hasNoConsecutiveCharacters(input) && hasNoSequentialCharacters(input)
      })
    }
  }, [input])

  return { validation, setValidation }
}

```

```typescript
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { PAGE_VALUES, RECOVERY_QUERY_PARAMS } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'

import { useAuthSlice } from './useAuthSlice'
import { useEncryptPassword } from './useEncryptPassword'

const {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { LOGIN }
  }
} = ROUTES

export const useRecoveryValidation = ({
  from,
  setOpenModal,
  setInfoModal
}: any) => {
  const { setFirstLogin } = useAuthSlice()
  const location = useLocation()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const { encodeData } = useEncryptPassword()

  useEffect(() => {
    const validate = async () => {
      const queryParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
      const email = queryParams.get(RECOVERY_QUERY_PARAMS.email) || ''
      const page = queryParams.get(RECOVERY_QUERY_PARAMS.page) || ''
      const decodedEmail = atob(email)

      if (page === PAGE_VALUES.recoveryPassword && email) {
        try {
          if (from !== 'home') {
            const { getToken, validateRecoveryURL } = await import(
              '@/features/auth/services/recoveryServices'
            )
            const { data } = await getToken()
            const token = data.access_token
            const cryptUrl = encodeData(window.location.href)
            const response = await validateRecoveryURL(
              decodedEmail,
              cryptUrl,
              token
            )

            if (response?.data?.messageRecoveryPasswordUrlExpire) {
              setOpenModal(true)
              debugger
              setInfoModal({
                title: 'Error',
                message: response.data.messageRecoveryPasswordUrlExpire,
                textSuccess: 'Entendido',
                variant: 'error',
                onClick: () => {
                  setOpenModal(false)
                  localStorage.clear()
                  navigate(LOGIN.path)
                }
              })
              return
            }
          }
          setFirstLogin(true)
          navigate(
            `/authentication/${PAGE_VALUES.newPassword}?${RECOVERY_QUERY_PARAMS.email}=${email}`
          )
        } catch (e) {
          const { default: isDevMode } = await import(
            '@/shared/utils/isDevMode'
          )
          if (isDevMode()) {
            console.error('Recovery error', e)
          }
        }
      } else if (email) {
        setFirstLogin(true)
        navigate(
          `/authentication/${PAGE_VALUES.landing}?${RECOVERY_QUERY_PARAMS.email}=${email}`
        )
      }
    }

    validate()
  }, [])
}
```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useTokenUser.ts

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  onError,
  onFirstLogin,
  onInfoUser,
  onLoading,
  onOtpIn,
  onMessageError,
  onTokenUser,
  onInfoUserNubo,
  onUsername,
  onBlocked,
  resetAuth
} from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import * as AuthService from '@/features/auth/services/auth'
import * as EmailService from '@/features/auth/services/email'
import * as UserService from '@/features/auth/services/user'
import { ErrorResponse } from '@/features/auth/types/errors'
import { type InfoModal } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'
import {
  handleUserUnable,
  isUserStatusError
} from '@/features/auth/utils/userStatusValidator'

import {
  API_HEADERS,
  ERROR_CODES,
  ERROR_MESSAGES,
  FAILED_ATTEMPT_MAP,
  HTTP_CODES,
  MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS,
  ORIGIN_OTP,
  USER_STATUS,
  USER_TYPES
} from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import isDevMode from '@/shared/utils/isDevMode'
import setFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/setFromLocalStorage'

import { sendSessionEmail } from '../services/email-actions/sendSession'
import { useEncryptPassword } from './useEncryptPassword'

type ForgotPassword = {
  setOpenModal: (state: boolean) => void
  setInfoModal: (state: InfoModal) => void
  setForgotPassword: (state: boolean) => void
  email?: string
}
type PreviousSession = {
  setOpenModal: (state: boolean) => void
  setInfoModal: (state: InfoModal) => void
}

const {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { TWO_FA, CONFIG_TWO_FA, NEW_PASSWORD, LOGIN }
  }
} = ROUTES

export const useTokenUser = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const dispatch = useDispatch()

  const { email, password, emailRecovery } = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) => state.auth
  )

  const [blockedTotal, setBlockedTotal] = useState(false)

  const { encodeData } = useEncryptPassword()
  const messageError = (message: string) => {
    dispatch(onMessageError(message))
    dispatch(onError(true))
  }

  const setTokenUser = async ({
    setOpenModal,
    setInfoModal
  }: PreviousSession) => {
    const encrypted = encodeData(password)

    try {
      dispatch(onLoading(true))
      dispatch(onError(false))
      dispatch(onMessageError(null))

      const { data } = await AuthService.getTokenWithPassword(email, encrypted)

      if (data?.previous_session) {
        setOpenModal(true)
        setInfoModal({
          title: 'Ya tiene una sesión activa',
          message: `Por favor cierre esa sesión e intente de nuevo`,
          textSuccess: 'Entendido',
          variant: 'warning',
          onClick: async () => {
            setOpenModal(false)
            await sendSessionEmail(email, data.access_token)
          }
        })
        sessionStorage.clear()
        return
      }

      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN, data.access_token)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.EMAIL, email)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.REFRESH_TOKEN, data.refresh_token)

      const responseInfoUserNubo = await AuthService.validateUser(
        email,
        data.access_token
      )

      const {
        id,
        userName,
        userType,
        failedAttempt,
        status,
        otp,
        participant,
        firstName,
        lastName,
        profile,
        identification,
        country,
        participants,
        participantAfp,
        participantSponsors,
        profiles,
        lastModifyDate
      } = responseInfoUserNubo.data

      dispatch(onTokenUser(data.access_token))
      setIntrospecToken(data.access_token)

      const response = await UserService.getUserKeycloak(
        email,
        data.access_token
      )

      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME, userName)
      dispatch(onUsername(userName))

      dispatch(onInfoUser(response.data))

      const { name: profileName, id: profileId } = profile

      const {
        name,
        id: participantId,
        country: countryParticipant,
        documentNumber,
        type: participantType,
        code
      } = participant
      dispatch(
        onInfoUserNubo({
          id,
          identification,
          userName,
          userType,
          failedAttempt,
          status,
          isOtp: otp,
          name,
          participantAfp,
          participantType,
          firstName,
          participantSponsors,
          lastName,
          participantId,
          country,
          participants,
          profiles,
          countryParticipant,
          profileName,
          profileId,
          documentNumber,
          code,
          lastModifyDate
        })
      )

      try {
        await AuthService.validateBlockedUser(userName, data.access_token)
      } catch (error) {
        const err = error as ErrorResponse
        if (
          err?.response?.data?.httpCode === HTTP_CODES.BAD_REQUEST &&
          err?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
            ERROR_CODES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS
        ) {
          const message = ERROR_MESSAGES.BLOCKED_ACCOUNT
          messageError(message)
          return
        }
        throw error
      }

      await UserService.validateUserByEmail(email, data.access_token)
      GenerateLogs(id!, {
        actionType: 'Inicio de sesion',
        actionDestination: `Usuario ${email} con contraseña ${encrypted} inicio sesion`,
        countryId: country.id,
        participantId: participantId,
        statusId: status.id,
        userNuboId: id
      })
      dispatch(onOtpIn(true))
      navigate(otp ? TWO_FA.path : CONFIG_TWO_FA.path)
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse
      const errorCode = err?.response?.data?.errorCode

      const match = err?.response?.data?.errorMessageDetail.match(
        /"error_description":"(.*?)"/
      )
      if (errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS) {
        dispatch(
          onInfoUserNubo({
            isBlocked: true
          })
        )
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS)
      }

      if (match && err?.response?.data?.httpCode === HTTP_CODES.BAD_REQUEST) {
        if (match[1] === 'Account is not fully set up') {
          const response = await changeToCredential('I need only the token')

          const responseTemporaryExp =
            await UserService.validatePasswordTemporaryExpiration(
              email,
              response.data.access_token
            )

          if (responseTemporaryExp?.data?.messagePasswordTemporaryExpire) {
            setOpenModal(true)
            setInfoModal({
              title: 'Contraseña temporal',
              message: `Su contraseña temporal ha expirado. Debes restablecer la contraseña para poder ingresar al sistema.`,
              textSuccess: 'Entendido',
              variant: 'warning',
              onClick: async () => {
                try {
                  setOpenModal(false)

                  const responseGeneratePassword =
                    await UserService.generateNewPassword(
                      email,
                      response.data.access_token
                    )

                  const resetPasswordBody = {
                    type: 'password',
                    value: responseGeneratePassword.data.password,
                    temporary: true
                  }

                  await UserService.resetTemporaryUserPassword(
                    email,
                    response.data.access_token,
                    responseGeneratePassword.data.idKeycloak,
                    resetPasswordBody
                  )

                  const formData = {
                    userName: email.toLowerCase(),
                    password: responseGeneratePassword.data.password
                  }

                  await EmailService.sendPasswordModifiedEmail(
                    formData,
                    email,
                    response.data.access_token
                  )
                  const responseInfoUserNubo =
                    await UserService.getUserInfoNubo(
                      email,
                      response.data.access_token
                    )
                  const { id, status, participant, country } =
                    responseInfoUserNubo.data

                  const { id: participantId } = participant

                  await GenerateLogs(
                    email.toLowerCase(),
                    {
                      actionType: `Se envia correo de contraseña temporal expirada del usuario ${email}`,
                      actionDestination: 'Homepage',
                      participantId: participantId,
                      countryId: country?.id,
                      userNuboId: id,
                      statusId: status.id
                    },
                    response.data.access_token
                  )
                } catch {
                  if (isDevMode()) {
                    console.log('Error contraseña temporal')
                  }
                }
              }
            })
            return
          }

          dispatch(onError(false))
          dispatch(onMessageError(null))
          dispatch(onFirstLogin(true))

          await changeToCredential('Account is not fully set up')
        }
      }
      if (isDevMode()) {
        console.error('Error al obtener el token:', err)
      }
      if (err?.response?.data?.httpCode === HTTP_CODES.UNAUTHORIZED) {
        const response = await changeToCredential('Invalid user credentials')
        if (response?.userTypeNubo === USER_TYPES.EXTERNAL)
          increaseFailed(
            response.data.access_token,
            'invalid',
            response.responseInfoUserNubo
          )
        if (response?.userTypeNubo === USER_TYPES.INTERNAL) {
          messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.INTERNAL_USER_MICROSOFT)
        }
        if (!response) {
          messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.INCORRECT_CREDENTIALS)
        }
      }

      if (
        err?.response?.data?.error === ERROR_CODES.ERROR_UNKNOWN ||
        err?.response?.data?.errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_NOT_FOUND
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.INCORRECT_CREDENTIALS)
      }

      if (isUserStatusError(errorCode || '')) {
        const status = await changeToCredential(ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS)
        const wasHandled = handleUserUnable(status.id.toString(), dispatch)
        if (!wasHandled) {
          messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.UNKNOWN_USER_STATUS)
        }
      }

      if (
        err?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
        ERROR_CODES.VALIDATE_USER_TYPE_ACCESS_TOKEN
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.INTERNAL_USER_MICROSOFT)
      }

      if (
        err?.response?.data?.httpCode &&
        err?.response?.data?.httpCode >= HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.SERVER_ERROR)
      }
    } finally {
      dispatch(onLoading(false))
    }
  }

  const setIntrospecToken = async (token: string) => {
    try {
      await AuthService.introspectToken(email, token)
    } catch {
      throw new Error('Token incorrecto')
    }
  }

  const changeToCredential = async (errorText: string) => {
    try {
      const { data } =
        await AuthService.getTokenClientByGrantType('client_credentials')

      if (errorText === ERROR_MESSAGES.ONLY_TOKEN_REQUIRED) {
        return { data }
      }

      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN, data.access_token)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.EMAIL, email)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME, email)
      setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.REFRESH_TOKEN, data.refresh_token)

      const userInfo = await UserService.getUserType(email, data.access_token)

      const { userType: userTypeNubo } = userInfo?.data

      const response = await AuthService.getKeycloakUser(
        email,
        data.access_token
      )

      if (
        (errorText === ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_USER_CREDENTIALS &&
          response?.data.length === 0) ||
        response?.data.status === USER_STATUS.BLOCKED
      )
        return

      const responseInfoUserNubo = await AuthService.getUserNuboInfo(
        email,
        data.access_token
      )

      if (errorText === ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_USER_CREDENTIALS) {
        return { data, userTypeNubo, responseInfoUserNubo }
      }

      const {
        id,
        userName,
        userType,
        failedAttempt,
        blocked,
        status,
        otp,
        participant,
        firstName,
        lastName,
        profile,
        participantAfp,
        participantSponsors,
        lastModifyDate
      } = responseInfoUserNubo.data

      if (errorText === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS) {
        return status
      }
      const { name: profileName, id: profileId } = profile
      const {
        name,
        id: participantId,
        country,
        documentNumber,
        type: participantType,
        code
      } = participant
      dispatch(
        onInfoUserNubo({
          id,
          userName,
          userType,
          failedAttempt,
          isBlocked: blocked,
          status,
          isOtp: otp,
          name,
          participantType,
          participantAfp,
          participantSponsors,
          firstName,
          lastName,
          participantId,
          country,
          profileName,
          profileId,
          documentNumber,
          code,
          lastModifyDate
        })
      )

      dispatch(onInfoUser(response?.data))

      setFromLocalStorage(
        STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME,
        responseInfoUserNubo?.data?.userName
      )
      dispatch(onUsername(responseInfoUserNubo?.data?.userName))

      if (errorText === ERROR_MESSAGES.ACCOUNT_SETUP_INCOMPLETE) {
        navigate(NEW_PASSWORD.path)
        return
      }

      dispatch(onTokenUser(data.access_token))
      setIntrospecToken(data.access_token)
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse
      const errorCode = err?.response?.data?.errorCode
      if (
        err?.response?.data?.error === ERROR_CODES.ERROR_UNKNOWN ||
        errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_NOT_FOUND
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
      }
      if (
        err?.response?.data?.httpCode &&
        err?.response?.data?.httpCode >= HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.SERVER_ERROR)
      }
    }
  }

  const increaseFailed = async (
    dataToken: string,
    origin: string,
    responseInfoUserNubo?: any
  ) => {
    const userNameState =
      responseInfoUserNubo?.data?.userName ?? responseInfoUserNubo?.userName

    try {
      dispatch(onLoading(true))
      const responseFailded = await UserService.increaseFailedAttempts(
        userNameState,
        dataToken
      )

      if (responseInfoUserNubo.data) {
        const {
          id = '',
          status,
          participant,
          country
        } = responseInfoUserNubo.data

        const { id: participantId } = participant

        await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
          actionType: `Inicio de sesión fallido vista Login #${responseInfoUserNubo.data.failedAttempt + 1}`,
          actionDestination: 'Homepage',
          participantId: participantId,
          countryId: country?.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        })
      } else {
        const { id, status, participantId, country } = responseInfoUserNubo

        await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
          actionType: `Inicio de sesión fallido vista 2FA #${responseInfoUserNubo.failedAttempt + 1}`,
          actionDestination: 'Homepage',
          participantId,
          countryId: country?.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        })
      }
      if (responseFailded?.data?.failedAttempt === MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED_LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
        setBlockedTotal(true)
        try {
          await EmailService.sendEmailBlockNotification(
            userNameState,
            dataToken
          )
        } catch {
          if (isDevMode()) {
            console.log('error en el envio de correo de bloqueo')
          }
        } finally {
          if (origin === ORIGIN_OTP) {
            dispatch(onLoading(true))
            setTimeout(() => {
              dispatch(resetAuth())
            }, 3000)
          }
        }
        return
      }
      if (responseFailded?.data?.isBlocked) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS)
        dispatch(onBlocked(true))
        return
      }

      const attempt = responseFailded?.data?.failedAttempt
      const failed = FAILED_ATTEMPT_MAP[attempt] ?? null

      if (failed) {
        const message =
          `${origin === ORIGIN_OTP ? ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_CODE : ERROR_MESSAGES.INVALID_CREDENTIALS}, ` +
          `tienes ${failed} intentos más, antes que tu cuenta sea bloqueada por 3 minutos.`

        messageError(message)
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse

      if (
        err?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
        ERROR_CODES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS)
        const { id, status, participant, country, email, failedAttempt } =
          responseInfoUserNubo.data

        await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
          actionType: `Usuario ${email} bloqueado por exceder el número de intentos permitidos ${failedAttempt + 1}`,
          actionDestination: 'Homepage',
          participantId: participant.id,
          countryId: country?.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        })
        dispatch(onBlocked(true))
      }

      if (err?.response?.data?.errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_BLOCKED) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED_LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
        setBlockedTotal(true)
        try {
          await EmailService.sendEmailBlockNotification(
            userNameState,
            dataToken
          )
        } catch {
          if (isDevMode()) {
            console.log('error en el envio de correo de bloqueo')
            // console.log('error en el envio de correo de bloqueo')
          }
        }
      }
      if (
        err?.response?.data?.errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_INACTIVE ||
        err?.response?.data?.errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_SUSPENDED
      ) {
        const status = await changeToCredential('USER_STATUS')

        let message
        if (status.id === parseInt(HTTP_CODES.INACTIVE)) {
          message = ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_INACTIVE
        }
        if (status.id === parseInt(HTTP_CODES.SUSPENDED)) {
          message = ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_SUSPENDED
        }

        dispatch(onMessageError(message))
        dispatch(onError(true))
      }
      if (
        err?.response?.status &&
        err?.response?.status >= parseInt(HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR)
      ) {
        messageError(ERROR_MESSAGES.SERVER_ERROR_SHORT)
      }
    } finally {
      dispatch(onLoading(false))
    }
  }

  const sendEmail = async ({
    setOpenModal,
    setInfoModal,
    setForgotPassword,
    email
  }: ForgotPassword) => {
    try {
      dispatch(onLoading(true))

      const { data } = await AuthService.getTokenClientByGrantType(
        API_HEADERS.GRANT_TYPE
      )

      const userName = email ? email.toLowerCase() : emailRecovery.toLowerCase()
      await AuthService.getKeycloakUser(userName, data.access_token)

      const responseInfoUserNubo = await UserService.getUserInfoNubo(
        userName,
        data.access_token
      )

      const { userType, id, status, participant, country } =
        responseInfoUserNubo.data
      const { id: participantId } = participant

      if (userType === USER_TYPES.INTERNAL) {
        const passwordChangeInfo =
          await UserService.getPasswordChangeInformation(
            userName,
            data.access_token
          )
        const contactEmail = passwordChangeInfo?.data?.email ?? ''
        const contactPhone = passwordChangeInfo?.data?.phoneNumber ?? ''
        setOpenModal(true)
        setInfoModal({
          title: 'Eres nuamer',
          message: `Para recuperar tu contraseña cómo usuario interno debes comunicarte con ${contactEmail} o al ${contactPhone}`,
          textSuccess: 'Entendido',
          variant: 'warning',
          onClick: () => {
            setOpenModal(false)
          }
        })
        setForgotPassword(false)
        return
      }

      await UserService.getUserKeycloak(userName, data.access_token)

      await EmailService.sendRecoveryEmail(userName, data.access_token)

      setForgotPassword(false)
      dispatch(onLoading(false))

      setInfoModal({
        title: 'Enlace enviado',
        message: `Hemos enviado un correo electrónico a ${userName} con un enlace para que recuperes el acceso a tu cuenta`,
        textSuccess: 'Entendido',
        onClick: () => {
          setOpenModal(false)
          if (email) navigate(LOGIN.path)
        }
      })
      setOpenModal(true)

      await GenerateLogs(
        emailRecovery,
        {
          actionType: `Recuperación de contraseña`,
          actionDestination: 'Homepage',
          participantId,
          countryId: country?.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        },
        data.access_token
      )
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse

      if (err?.response?.status === parseInt(HTTP_CODES.NOT_FOUND)) {
        setInfoModal({
          title: 'No encontramos una cuenta asociada a este correo',
          message: `Verifica el correo ingresado e intenta nuevamente`,
          textSuccess: 'Reintentar',
          variant: 'error',
          onClick: () => {
            setOpenModal(false)
            setForgotPassword(true)
          }
        })
        setForgotPassword(false)
        setOpenModal(true)
      }
      if (
        err?.response?.status &&
        err?.response?.status >= parseInt(HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR)
      ) {
        setOpenModal(true)
        setInfoModal({
          title: 'Error del servidor',
          message: `Intenta mas tarde`,
          textSuccess: 'Entendido',
          variant: 'error',
          onClick: () => {
            setOpenModal(false)
          }
        })
        setForgotPassword(false)
      }
    } finally {
      dispatch(onLoading(false))
    }
  }

  return {
    setTokenUser,
    sendEmail,
    increaseFailed,
    blockedTotal
  }
}
```

## src/features/auth/hooks/useTwoFactor.ts

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { onFirstLogin, onOtpIn } from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import * as TwoFactorService from '@/features/auth/services/twoFactor'
import { InfoModal } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'

import {
  LOCAL_KEYS,
  MIN_OTP_LENGTH,
  OTP_ACTIONS
} from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import { LocalStorageProps } from '@/shared/types/LocalStorageProps'
import isDevMode from '@/shared/utils/isDevMode'
import getFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/getFromLocalStorage'

import { useAuthSlice } from './useAuthSlice'
import { useDecryptPassword } from './useDecryptPassword'
import { useTokenUser } from './useTokenUser'

interface Payload {
  username: string
  setLoading: (payload: boolean) => void
  setLoggedIn: (payload: boolean) => void
  setInfoModal: (arg: InfoModal) => void
  setOpenModal: (payload: boolean) => void
  setOtpSecret: (arg: string) => void
  setMessageError: (arg: string) => void
  setError: (arg: boolean) => void
}

const {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { LOGIN }
  }
} = ROUTES

export const useTwoFactor = ({
  username,
  setLoading,
  setLoggedIn,
  setInfoModal,
  setOpenModal,
  setOtpSecret,
  setMessageError,
  setError
}: Payload) => {
  const [authentication, setAuthentication] = useState('')
  const [urlQr, setUrlQr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [errorCode, setErrorCode] = useState('')
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const dispatch = useDispatch()

  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)

  const { increaseFailed, blockedTotal } = useTokenUser()

  const { decodeData } = useDecryptPassword()

  const { logoutUser } = useAuthSlice()

  const token = getFromLocalStorage(LOCAL_KEYS.TOKEN as LocalStorageProps)

  useEffect(() => {
    sessionStorage.clear()
    const getQr = async () => {
      const responseOtp = await TwoFactorService.getOTP(username, token!)
      setUrlQr(responseOtp.data.otpSecretImageUri)
      setOtpSecret(decodeData(responseOtp.data.otpSecret))
    }
    getQr()
  }, [])

  const handleInput = (_label: string, value: string) => {
    if (value.trim().length >= MIN_OTP_LENGTH) {
      setAuthentication(value)
    }
    if (value.length < MIN_OTP_LENGTH) {
      setAuthentication('')
    }
  }

  const handlePress = async (payload: string) => {
    if (payload === OTP_ACTIONS.VERIFY) {
      try {
        setLoading(true)
        await TwoFactorService.validateOTP(username, token!, authentication)

        await TwoFactorService.resetFailedAttempts(username, token!)

        await TwoFactorService.validateLogin(username, token!)

        const { id, status, participantId, country } = infoUserNubo
        await GenerateLogs(username, {
          actionType: `Inicio de sesión exitoso`,
          actionDestination: 'Homepage',
          participantId,
          countryId: country.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        })
        setOpenModal(true)
        setErrorCode('')
        setError(false)
        setMessageError('')
        setInfoModal({
          title: 'factor de doble autenticación activado',
          message: '',
          textSuccess: 'Iniciar Sesión',
          onClick: () => {
            setOpenModal(false)
            dispatch(onFirstLogin(false))
            dispatch(onOtpIn(false))
            logoutUser()
            navigate(LOGIN.path)
          }
        })
      } catch (error) {
        if (isDevMode()) {
          console.log('🚀 ~ handlePress ~ error:', error)
        }
        await increaseFailed(token!, 'otp', infoUserNubo)
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }
    if (payload === OTP_ACTIONS.BACK) {
      setErrorCode('')
      setError(false)
      setMessageError('')
      setLoggedIn(false)
      navigate(LOGIN.path)
    }
  }

  return {
    urlQr,
    errorCode,
    authentication,
    handleInput,
    handlePress,
    blockedTotal
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { useMsal } from '@azure/msal-react'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { ModalAlert, Spinner } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { NewPassword } from '@/features/auth/components/NewPassword'
import { PasswordCharacteristics } from '@/features/auth/components/PasswordCharacteristics'
import { useAuthSlice } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useAuthSlice'
import { useLogin } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useLogin'
import { usePasswordValidation } from '@/features/auth/hooks/usePasswordValidation'
import { type InfoModal } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'

import { QUERY_PARAMS } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { useIsMobileOrTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import { getDecodedEmailFromURL } from '@/shared/utils/getDecodedEmailFromURL'

import IsMobileRestricted from '../components/IsMobileRestricted'

const ChangePassword = () => {
  const [openModal, setOpenModal] = useState(true)
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [errorEmail, setErrorEmail] = useState('')
  const [infoModal, setInfoModal] = useState<InfoModal>({
    title: 'Cambio de contraseña',
    message:
      'Debes cambiar la contraseña predeterminada para poder ingresar al sistema.',
    textSuccess: 'Entendido',
    variant: 'warning',
    onClick: () => setOpenModal(false)
  })

  const {
    AUTHENTICATION: {
      subRoutes: { LOGIN }
    }
  } = ROUTES

  const { instance } = useMsal()

  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('')

  const { loading, reviewUser, setForgotPassword, forgotPassword, logoutUser } =
    useAuthSlice()
  const { handleClose } = useLogin({
    errorEmail,
    setErrorEmail,
    instance,
    setOpenModal,
    setInfoModal
  })

  const { validation, setValidation } = usePasswordValidation(newPassword)
  const isMobile = useIsMobileOrTablet()

  const navigate = useNavigate()

  useEffect(() => {
    const decodedEmail = getDecodedEmailFromURL(QUERY_PARAMS.EMAIL_KEY)
    setEmail(decodedEmail)
    reviewUser({ navigate, email: decodedEmail })
  }, [location])

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <>
        <IsMobileRestricted />
      </>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="container-change flex gap-120">
      {loading && <Spinner />}
      {forgotPassword && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="Enlace caducado"
          message="El enlace para restablecer la contraseña ha caducado, deseas recibir un nuevo enlace?."
          textSuccess="Reenviar"
          onClick={() =>
            handleClose({
              setOpenModal,
              setInfoModal,
              setForgotPassword,
              email: email
            })
          }
          variant="warning"
          handleCancel={() => {
            setForgotPassword(false)
            logoutUser()
            navigate(LOGIN.path)
          }}
        />
      )}
      {openModal && !forgotPassword && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={infoModal.title}
          message={infoModal.message}
          variant={infoModal.variant}
          textSuccess={infoModal.textSuccess}
          onClick={infoModal.onClick}
        />
      )}
      <NewPassword
        validation={validation}
        setValidation={setValidation}
        newPassword={newPassword}
        setPassword={setNewPassword}
        setOpenModal={setOpenModal}
        setInfoModal={setInfoModal}
      />
      <PasswordCharacteristics validation={validation} />
    </div>
  )
}

export default ChangePassword
```
