```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Link,
  Typography,
  MaterialIcons
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react'

import {
  ModalAlert,
  InputLogin,
  Spinner,
  TimeBlock,
  Error
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { QrCode } from '@/features/auth/components/QrCode'
import { stepsDescriptions } from '@/features/auth/constants/twoFactor'
import { useAuthSlice } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useAuthSlice'
import { useTwoFactor } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useTwoFactor'
import '@/features/auth/styles/factorStyles.css'
import { type InfoModal } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'

import { useIsMobileOrTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet'

const CodeManual = lazy(() =>
  import('@/features/auth/components/CodeManual').then((module) => ({
    default: module.CodeManual
  }))
)
const IsMobileRestricted = lazy(
  () => import('../components/IsMobileRestricted')
)

const ConfigTwoFactorAuth = () => {
  const [openModal, setOpenModal] = useState(false)
  const [openCodeManual, setOpenCodeManual] = useState(false)
  const [otpSecret, setOtpSecret] = useState('')
  const [infoModal, setInfoModal] = useState<InfoModal>({
    title: '',
    message: '',
    textSuccess: '',
    variant: '',
    onClick: () => {}
  })
  const isMobile = useIsMobileOrTablet()

  const {
    loading,
    username,
    error,
    isBlocked,
    messageError,
    setLoading,
    setLoggedIn,
    setResetFailed,
    setMessageError,
    setError
  } = useAuthSlice()

  const { urlQr, authentication, handleInput, handlePress, blockedTotal } =
    useTwoFactor({
      username,
      setLoading,
      setLoggedIn,
      setInfoModal,
      setOpenModal,
      setOtpSecret,
      setMessageError,
      setError
    })

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <>
        <IsMobileRestricted />
      </>
    )
  }

  return (
    <>
      {loading && <Spinner />}
      {openModal && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={infoModal.title}
          message={infoModal.message}
          variant={infoModal.variant}
          textSuccess={infoModal.textSuccess}
          onClick={infoModal.onClick}
        />
      )}
      {openCodeManual && (
        <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
          <CodeManual code={otpSecret} setOpenCodeManual={setOpenCodeManual} />
        </Suspense>
      )}
      {!isBlocked ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          transition={{
            duration: 0.1,
            delay: 0.01,
            ease: [0, 0.71, 0.1, 1]
          }}
        >
          <Card className="flex flex-col p-[26px]">
            <div className="container-top-factor">
              <div className="container-icon-factor">
                <MaterialIcons.GppGoodOutlined fontSize="large" />
              </div>
              <Typography
                variant="h5"
                className="mb-[24px] mt-[24px] text-center"
              >
                Activa el factor de doble autenticación
              </Typography>
            </div>
            <div className="container-bottom-factor">
              <div className="container-qr-factor">
                <QrCode qrUrl={urlQr} />
                <Typography variant="caption">
                  ¿No puedes escanear el código? Puedes ingresa el&#8192;
                  <Link
                    color="secondary"
                    onClick={() => setOpenCodeManual(true)}
                    style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  >
                    código manualmente
                  </Link>
                </Typography>
              </div>
              <div className="container-steps-factor">
                {stepsDescriptions.map((steps) => (
                  <div key={steps.id}>
                    <Typography variant="body1" className="font-bold">
                      {steps.id}. {steps.title}
                    </Typography>
                    <div className="step-subtitle">
                      <Typography variant="body1">{steps.subtitle}</Typography>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {error && messageError && (
                  <Error
                    type="error"
                    icon="dangerIcon"
                    message={messageError}
                  />
                )}
                <InputLogin
                  id="OTP"
                  label="Ingresar código"
                  type="text"
                  identifyInput={handleInput}
                  placeholder="Ingresar código"
                  maxLength={6}
                  error={error && messageError && 'Código inválido'}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-6 flex w-full justify-end gap-x-3">
              <Button
                variant="outlined"
                onClick={() => handlePress('back')}
                color="secondary"
                style={{
                  color: '#FF4201',
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255, 66, 1, 0.5)'
                }}
              >
                Cancelar
              </Button>
              <Button
                disabled={blockedTotal ? true : !authentication}
                onClick={() => handlePress('verify')}
              >
                Activar
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="flex h-[350px] w-[456px] flex-col gap-y-6 bg-white p-12"
          style={{ borderRadius: '4px 20px 4px 20px' }}
        >
          <Error type="error" icon="dangerIcon" message={messageError} />
          <TimeBlock reset={setResetFailed} />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
export default ConfigTwoFactorAuth

```

```tsx
import { useMsal } from '@azure/msal-react'
import {
  Button,
  Typography,
  Divider,
  Link,
  Card,
  MaterialIcons
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import ReCAPTCHA from 'react-google-recaptcha'
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import validator from 'validator'

import {
  Spinner,
  ModalAlert,
  Error,
  InputLogin
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { useAuth } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useAuth'
import { useLogin } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useLogin'
import { useMicrosoftUser } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useMicrosoftUser'
import { useRecoveryValidation } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useRecoveryValidation'
import '@/features/auth/styles/loginStyles.css'

import backgroundLogin from '@/shared/assets/login.svg'
import logo_nuam from '@/shared/assets/nubo.svg'
import { LOGIN_FORM_TEXT } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { useIsMobileOrTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet'

const IsMobile = lazy(() => import('../components/IsMobile'))
const BlockedUser = lazy(() => import('../components/BlockedUser'))

const RecoveryModal = lazy(
  () => import('@/features/auth/components/RecoveryModal')
)
const Login = () => {
  const [captchaKey, setCaptchaKey] = useState(0)
  const [openModal, setOpenModal] = useState(false)
  const [errorEmail, setErrorEmail] = useState('')
  const [infoModal, setInfoModal] = useState<any>({})
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const location = useLocation()
  const { from } = location.state || {}
  const { instance } = useMsal()
  const isMobile = useIsMobileOrTablet()

  const {
    identifyInput,
    handlePress,
    handlePressMicrosoft,
    handleBlur,
    handleClose
  } = useLogin({
    errorEmail,
    setErrorEmail,
    instance,
    setOpenModal,
    setInfoModal
  })

  const {
    email,
    password,
    emailRecovery,
    error,
    messageError,
    loading,
    recaptcha,
    forgotPassword,
    isBlocked,
    setRecaptcha,
    setForgotPassword,
    setResetFailed
  } = useAuth()

  useMicrosoftUser({ instance, navigate, setOpenModal, setInfoModal })
  useRecoveryValidation({ from, setOpenModal, setInfoModal })
  useEffect(() => {
    setCaptchaKey((prev) => prev + 1)
    setRecaptcha(null)
    localStorage.clear()
  }, [])

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
        <IsMobile />
      </Suspense>
    )
  }

  return (
    <>
      {loading && <Spinner />}
      {openModal && (
        <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
          <ModalAlert {...infoModal} />
        </Suspense>
      )}
      {forgotPassword && (
        <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
          <RecoveryModal
            email={emailRecovery}
            errorEmail={errorEmail}
            identifyInput={identifyInput}
            handleBlur={handleBlur}
            onAccept={() =>
              handleClose({ setOpenModal, setInfoModal, setForgotPassword })
            }
            setForgotPassword={setForgotPassword}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}

      <img
        src={backgroundLogin}
        alt="background"
        className="absolute z-0 h-full w-full object-cover object-center"
      />
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{
          duration: 0.1,
          delay: 0.01,
          ease: [0, 0.71, 0.1, 1]
        }}
      >
        <img
          src={logo_nuam}
          alt="logo"
          className="logo pb-6 md:w-[180px] lg:w-[193px] xl:w-[200px] 2xl:w-[220px]"
        />
        {!isBlocked ? (
          <>
            <Card
              className="relative z-[1] w-[442px] p-[20px] lg:p-[26px]"
              sx={{ borderRadius: '16px' }}
            >
              <Typography variant="h5" className="mb-4 lg:mb-6">
                {LOGIN_FORM_TEXT.title}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h6" className="mb-3">
                {LOGIN_FORM_TEXT.internal}
              </Typography>
              <Button
                fullWidth
                onClick={handlePressMicrosoft}
                className="mb-[26px] h-[42px]"
                sx={{ background: '#0F6CBD' }}
              >
                <MaterialIcons.Microsoft className="mr-[6px]" />
                Ingresar con Microsoft
              </Button>
              <Divider className="!my-5 lg:!my-6" />
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 md:gap-4">
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {LOGIN_FORM_TEXT.external}
                </Typography>
                {error && messageError && (
                  <div className="mb-[24px]">
                    <Error type="error" message={messageError} />
                  </div>
                )}
                <InputLogin
                  label="Correo"
                  id="correo"
                  type="text"
                  identifyInput={identifyInput}
                  onBlur={handleBlur}
                  error={errorEmail}
                />
                <InputLogin
                  label="Contraseña"
                  id="contraseña"
                  type="password"
                  identifyInput={identifyInput}
                  isPassword
                  maxLength={20}
                />
                <div className="flex h-[74px] w-full items-center justify-center">
                  <ReCAPTCHA
                    key={captchaKey}
                    sitekey={import.meta.env.VITE_KEY_CAPTCHA}
                    size="normal"
                    type="image"
                    theme="light"
                    onChange={setRecaptcha}
                  />
                </div>
                <Button
                  fullWidth
                  className="h-[42px]"
                  disabled={
                    !(recaptcha && validator.isEmail(email) && password)
                  }
                  onClick={handlePress}
                >
                  Ingresar como externo
                </Button>
                <Link
                  underline="always"
                  fontSize={'14px'}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setForgotPassword(true)
                    setErrorEmail('')
                  }}
                  className="w-fit"
                >
                  {LOGIN_FORM_TEXT.forgotPassword}
                </Link>
              </div>
            </Card>
            <Typography className="absolute bottom-[26px] left-0 w-full text-center text-lg font-bold">
              Powered by nuam
            </Typography>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
            <BlockedUser
              setResetFailed={setResetFailed}
              messageError={messageError}
            />
          </Suspense>
        )}
      </motion.div>
    </>
  )
}
export default Login

```

## src/features/auth/pages/Logout.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Typography } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { Spinner } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { useAuthSlice } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useAuthSlice'
import '@/features/auth/styles/logoutStyles.css'

import { QUERY_PARAMS } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { useIsMobileOrTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet'

const IsMobileRestricted = lazy(
  () => import('../components/IsMobileRestricted')
)
const Logout = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const { reviewUser, logoutUser } = useAuthSlice()
  const isMobile = useIsMobileOrTablet()

  useEffect(() => {
    const queryParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
    const email = queryParams.get(QUERY_PARAMS.EMAIL_KEY) || ''

    reviewUser({ navigate, email: atob(email) })
  }, [location])

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
        <IsMobileRestricted />
      </Suspense>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="container-logout">
      <Card className="p-[26px]">
        <Typography variant="h5" className="mb-[24px]">
          Puedes cerrar sesión
        </Typography>

        <Button fullWidth onClick={() => logoutUser()}>
          Cerrar sesión
        </Button>
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}

export default Logout

```

## src/features/auth/pages/SelectParticipant.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Typography } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react'
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { Spinner } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import '@/features/auth/styles/loginStyles.css'

import backgroundNubo from '@/shared/assets/login.svg'
import logo_nuam from '@/shared/assets/nubo.svg'
import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
import { useIsMobileOrTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import getCurrentDateTime from '@/shared/utils/getCurrentDateTime'

import { useAuthSlice } from '../hooks/useAuthSlice'
import { type IParticipant, type IProfile } from '../types/selectParticipant'

const IsMobileRestricted = lazy(
  () => import('../components/IsMobileRestricted')
)
const {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { LOGIN }
  },
  HOME
} = ROUTES

export const SelectParticipant = () => {
  sessionStorage.clear()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const {
    setSessionStartTime,
    username,
    token,
    setLoggedIn,
    setError,
    setMessageError
  } = useAuthSlice()
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const isMobile = useIsMobileOrTablet()

  const handleSelectParticipant = async (participantSelected: IParticipant) => {
    const { default: setFromLocalStorage } =
      await import('@/shared/utils/localStorage/setFromLocalStorage')
    const { updateUser } = await import('../services/user')
    const { validateLogin } = await import('../services/twoFactor')

    const { onLoggedIn, onInfoUserNubo } =
      await import('remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice')
    const sessionTime = getCurrentDateTime()
    await validateLogin(username, token!)
    const responseInfoUserNubo = await updateUser(
      username,
      token,
      infoUserNubo.id,
      {
        participantId: participantSelected.id,
        profileId: participantSelected.profileId
      }
    )

    const {
      id,
      userName,
      userType,
      failedAttempt,
      blocked,
      status,
      otp,
      participant,
      firstName,
      lastName,
      profile,
      identification,
      country,
      participants,
      participantSponsors,
      participantAfp,
      profiles,
      lastModifyDate
    } = responseInfoUserNubo.data

    const { name: profileName, id: profileId } = profile
    const {
      name,
      id: participantId,
      country: countryParticipant,
      documentNumber,
      type: participantType,
      code
    } = participant
    dispatch(
      onInfoUserNubo({
        id,
        identification,
        userName,
        userType,
        failedAttempt,
        isBlocked: blocked,
        status,
        participantAfp,
        participantType,
        participantSponsors,
        isOtp: otp,
        name,
        firstName,
        lastName,
        participantId,
        country,
        participants,
        profiles,
        countryParticipant,
        profileName,
        profileId,
        documentNumber,
        code,
        lastModifyDate
      })
    )
    setError(false)
    setMessageError('')
    setSessionStartTime(sessionTime)
    setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_START_TIME, sessionTime)
    dispatch(onLoggedIn(true))
    setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.LOGGED_IN, 'true')
    navigate(HOME.path)
  }

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    const { onOtpIn } = await import('remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice')
    setError(false)
    setMessageError('')
    setLoggedIn(false)
    dispatch(onOtpIn(false))
    navigate(LOGIN.path)
  }

  const participantList =
    infoUserNubo.participantSponsors &&
    Array.isArray(infoUserNubo.participantSponsors)
      ? infoUserNubo.participantSponsors
      : infoUserNubo.participants

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
        <IsMobileRestricted />
      </Suspense>
    )
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="background-main" />
      <img
        src={backgroundNubo}
        alt="background"
        className="absolute -z-10 h-full w-full object-cover object-center"
      />
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.1, delay: 0.01, ease: [0, 0.71, 0.1, 1] }}
      >
        <img
          src={logo_nuam}
          alt="logo"
          className="logo mb-3 md:w-[180px] lg:w-[220px] xl:w-[240px] 2xl:w-[260px]"
        />
        <Card className="relative z-[1] w-[461px] p-[16px]">
          <Typography variant="h5" className="mb-[24px] text-center">
            Elige un participante para ingresar
          </Typography>

          <div className="mb-[32px] space-y-4">
            {participantList.map((participant: IParticipant) => {
              const profile = infoUserNubo.profiles?.find(
                (p: IProfile) => p.participant?.id === participant.id
              )
              return (
                <button
                  key={participant.id}
                  type="button"
                  className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-[4px] p-4 text-left focus:outline-none"
                  style={{
                    boxShadow: `
            0px 2px 1px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
            0px 1px 1px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14),
            0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)
          `
                  }}
                  onClick={() =>
                    handleSelectParticipant({
                      ...participant,
                      profileId: profile?.id
                    })
                  }
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Typography variant="body1">
                          {participant.shortName}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography
                          variant="caption"
                          className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-3 py-1 text-gray-700"
                        >
                          {participant.country.name}
                        </Typography>
                      </div>
                      <Typography variant="caption">
                        {profile?.name ?? 'Sin perfil'}
                      </Typography>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="text"
            fullWidth
            className="text-[15px] text-[#ff4201]"
            onClick={handleLogout}
          >
            Cerrar sesión
          </Button>
        </Card>
        <Typography className="absolute bottom-[26px] left-0 w-full text-center text-lg font-bold">
          Powered by nuam
        </Typography>
      </motion.div>
    </>
  )
}
export default SelectParticipant
```

## src/features/auth/pages/TwoFactor.tsx

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  TextField,
  Typography
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react'
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  onOtpIn,
  onSelectParticipant,
  onLoggedIn,
  onInfoUserNubo
} from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  Spinner,
  Error,
  GenerateLogs
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { useAuthSlice } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useAuthSlice'
import { useTokenUser } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useTokenUser'
import {
  resetFailedAttempts,
  validateLogin,
  validateOTP
} from '@/features/auth/services/twoFactor'
import '@/features/auth/styles/twoFactorStyles.css'

import ShieldDone from '@/shared/assets/shield_done.svg'
import { OTP_ACTIONS } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
// import STORAGE_KEYS from '@/shared/constants/storageKeys'
import { useIsMobileOrTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet'
import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'
import getCurrentDateTime from '@/shared/utils/getCurrentDateTime'
// import getCurrentDateTime from '@/shared/utils/getCurrentDateTime'
import isDevMode from '@/shared/utils/isDevMode'
import setFromLocalStorage from '@/shared/utils/localStorage/setFromLocalStorage'

import { getUserInfoNubo, updateUser } from '../services/user'

const BlockedUser = lazy(() => import('../components/BlockedUser'))
const IsMobileRestricted = lazy(
  () => import('../components/IsMobileRestricted')
)
const {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { LOGIN, SELECT_PARTICIPANT }
  },
  HOME
} = ROUTES

export const TwoFactor = () => {
  sessionStorage.clear()

  const [authentication, setAuthentication] = useState('')
  // const [errorCode, setErrorCode] = useState('')
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  const {
    loading,
    username,
    token,
    error,
    messageError,
    isBlocked,
    setLoading,
    setLoggedIn,
    setResetFailed,
    setMessageError,
    setError,
    setSessionStartTime
  } = useAuthSlice()

  const { increaseFailed, blockedTotal } = useTokenUser()

  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)

  const isMobile = useIsMobileOrTablet()

  const handleInput = (value: string) => {
    if (/^\d{0,6}$/.test(value)) {
      setAuthentication(value)
    }
  }

  const handleVerifyOTP = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true)
      await validateOTP(username, token!, authentication)
      await resetFailedAttempts(username, token!)

      const {
        id,
        status,
        participantId,
        country,
        participants,
        participantSponsors,
        participantAfp
      } = infoUserNubo

      await GenerateLogs(username, {
        actionType: `Inicio de sesión exitoso`,
        actionDestination: 'Homepage',
        participantId,
        countryId: country.id,
        userNuboId: id,
        statusId: status.id
      })
      const participantsToCheck = participantAfp
        ? participantSponsors
        : participants

      if (participantsToCheck.length === 1) {
        await validateLogin(username, token!)
        const responseInfoUserNubo = await getUserInfoNubo(username, token)

        const {
          id,
          userName,
          userType,
          failedAttempt,
          blocked,
          status,
          otp,
          participant,
          firstName,
          lastName,
          profile,
          identification,
          country,
          participants,
          participantAfp,
          participantSponsors,
          profiles,
          lastModifyDate
        } = responseInfoUserNubo.data

        const findProfile = profiles.find(
          (profile: any) => profile?.participant?.id === participants[0]?.id
        )
        const { name: profileName } = profile
        if (findProfile) {
          await updateUser(username, token, infoUserNubo.id, {
            participantId: findProfile?.participant?.id,
            profileId: findProfile?.id
          })
        }
        const {
          name,
          country: countryParticipant,
          documentNumber,
          type: participantType,
          code
        } = participant
        dispatch(
          onInfoUserNubo({
            id,
            identification,
            userName,
            userType,
            failedAttempt,
            isBlocked: blocked,
            status,
            participantSponsors,
            participantAfp,
            participantType,
            isOtp: otp,
            name,
            firstName,
            lastName,
            participantId: findProfile?.participant?.id,
            country,
            participants,
            profiles,
            countryParticipant,
            profileName,
            profileId: findProfile?.id,
            documentNumber,
            code,
            lastModifyDate
          })
        )
        const sessionTime = getCurrentDateTime()
        setSessionStartTime(sessionTime)
        setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_START_TIME, sessionTime)
        setError(false)
        setMessageError('')
        // setErrorCode('')
        dispatch(onLoggedIn(true))
        setFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.LOGGED_IN, 'true')
        navigate(HOME.path)
      } else {
        setError(false)
        setMessageError('')
        // setErrorCode('')
        dispatch(onSelectParticipant(true))
        navigate(SELECT_PARTICIPANT.path)
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (isDevMode()) {
        console.error('OTP validation failed:', err)
      }
      await increaseFailed(token!, 'otp', infoUserNubo)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleBack = () => {
    setError(false)
    setMessageError('')
    // setErrorCode('')
    setLoggedIn(false)
    dispatch(onOtpIn(false))
    navigate(LOGIN.path)
  }

  const handlePressOTP = (action: string) => {
    if (action === OTP_ACTIONS.VERIFY) handleVerifyOTP()
    if (action === OTP_ACTIONS.BACK) handleBack()
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
        <IsMobileRestricted />
      </Suspense>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="main-container-two-factor">
      {loading && <Spinner />}
      {!isBlocked ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          transition={{
            duration: 0.1,
            delay: 0.01,
            ease: [0, 0.71, 0.1, 1]
          }}
        >
          <Card className="container-auth-two-factor">
            <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-center">
              <img src={ShieldDone} alt="shield-done" />
            </div>
            <Typography variant="h5" className="mb-[24px] mt-[24px]">
              Autenticación de 2 factores
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" className="mb-[24px]">
              Ingresa a tu aplicación de autenticación para ver tu código de
              autenticación
            </Typography>
            {error && messageError && (
              <Error type="error" icon="dangerIcon" message={messageError} />
            )}
            <TextField
              label="Ingresar código"
              id="Código-autenticación"
              type="text"
              onChange={handleInput}
              placeholder="Ingresar código"
              slotProps={{
                htmlInput: { maxLength: 6 }
              }}
              error={error && messageError && 'Código inválido'}
              className="mb-[24px]"
              value={authentication}
              size="small"
              fullWidth
            />
            <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-y-3">
              <Button
                fullWidth
                disabled={
                  blockedTotal
                    ? true
                    : !authentication || authentication.length < 6
                }
                onClick={() => handlePressOTP('verify')}
              >
                Verificar
              </Button>
              <Button
                fullWidth
                variant="outlined"
                onClick={() => handlePressOTP('back')}
                style={{
                  color: '#FF4201',
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255, 66, 1, 0.5)'
                }}
              >
                Volver
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        // <div
        //   className="flex h-[350px] w-[456px] flex-col gap-y-6 bg-white p-12"
        //   style={{ borderRadius: '4px 20px 4px 20px' }}
        // >
        //   <Error type="error" icon="dangerIcon" message={messageError} />
        //   <TimeBlock reset={setResetFailed} />
        // </div>
        <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
          <BlockedUser
            setResetFailed={setResetFailed}
            messageError={messageError}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export default TwoFactor

```

```typescript
import { httpUserManagment } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { API_HEADERS } from '@/shared/constants/auth'
import { API_ROUTES } from '@/shared/constants/endpoints'
import {
  buildCustomHeaders,
  buildStandardHeaders
} from '@/shared/utils/headerServices'

export const getTokenWithPassword = (email: string, password: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.GET_TOKEN, null, {
    headers: buildCustomHeaders({
      client_user: email.toLowerCase(),
      client_password: password
    })
  })
}

export const getTokenClientByGrantType = (type: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.GET_TOKEN, null, {
    headers: buildCustomHeaders({
      grant_type: type
    })
  })
}

export const introspectToken = (email: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.INTROSPECT, null, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
  })
}

export const validateRecoveryURL = (
  username: string,
  cryptUrl: string,
  token: string
) => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(
    API_ROUTES.VALIDATE_RECOVERY_PASSWORD_URL(username),
    {
      urlRecoveryPassword: cryptUrl
    },
    {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
    }
  )
}

export const fetchToken = (username: string) =>
  httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.GET_TOKEN, null, {
    headers: {
      ...buildStandardHeaders(username),
      grant_type: API_HEADERS.GRANT_TYPE
    }
  })

// export const fetchUserInfo = (username: string, token: string) =>
//   httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.GET_USER_INFO(username), {
//     headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
//   })

export const fetchKeycloakUser = (username: string, token: string) =>
  httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.GET_KEYCLOAK_USER(username), {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
  })

export const validateUser = (username: string, token: string) =>
  httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.VALIDATE_USER(username), {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
  })

export const resetPassword = (
  id: string,
  password: string,
  user: string,
  token: string
) => {
  return httpUserManagment.put(
    API_ROUTES.RESET_PASSWORD(id),
    {
      type: 'password',
      value: password,
      temporary: false
    },
    {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(user, token)
    }
  )
}

export const resetUserBlocked = (user: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.RESET_BLOCKED(user), null, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(user, token)
  })
}

export const getUserNuboInfo = (email: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.GET_USER_INFO(email), {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
  })
}

export const getKeycloakUser = (username: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.GET_KEYCLOAK_USER(username), {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
  })
}

export const logoutUser = (username: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.LOGOUT(username), null, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
  })
}

export const getToken = () => {
  return httpUserManagment.post(API_ROUTES.GET_TOKEN, null, {
    headers: buildCustomHeaders({
      grant_type: API_HEADERS.GRANT_TYPE
    })
  })
}

export const validateBlockedUser = (username: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.get(`${API_ROUTES.VALIDATE_BLOCKED(username)}`, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(username, token)
  })
}
```

## src/features/auth/services/sendEmail.ts

```typescript
import axios from 'axios'

import { httpEmailApi } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { buildStandardHeaders } from '@/shared/utils/headerServices'

import { SendEmailParams } from '../types/sendEmail'

export const sendEmailUser = async ({
  email,
  formData,
  token
}: {
  formData: SendEmailParams
  email: string
  token: string
}): Promise<any> => {
  try {
    const headers = buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
    const response = await httpEmailApi.post(
      `/notification/send-email/code-template/user?userName=${email}`,
      formData,
      {
        headers
      }
    )

    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    if (axios.isAxiosError(error) && error.response) {
      throw new Error(
        error.response.data.error ||
          error.response.data.errorMessage ||
          'Failed to send email template'
      )
    }
    throw new Error('Failed to send email template')
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { buildStandardHeaders } from '@/shared/utils/headerServices'

export const getPasswordChangeInformation = (email: string, token: string) =>
  httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.PASSWORD_CHANGE_INFORMATION, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
  })

// export const getUserNuboByEmail = (email: string, token: string) =>
//   httpUserManagment.get(`${API_ROUTES.USER_BY_EMAIL}/${email.toLowerCase()}`, {
//     headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
//   })

export const getUserKeycloak = (email: string, token: string) =>
  httpUserManagment.get(
    `${API_ROUTES.USER_KEYCLOAK}?userName=${email.toLowerCase()}`,
    {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
    }
  )

export const getUserType = (email: string, token: string) =>
  httpUserManagment.get(API_ROUTES.USER_TYPE(email.toLowerCase()), {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
  })

export const validateTemporaryPassword = (email: string, token: string) =>

    `${API_ROUTES.SEND_EMAIL_BLOCK_USER}?userName=${email.toLowerCase()}`,

    {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)

      headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)

  newPassword: string,
  email: string,

    type: 'password',

    temporary: true

      headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)

      headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
    }
  )
}

  token: string,
  idKeycloak: string,
  resetPasswordBody: Record<string, any>
) => {

    `${API_ROUTES.RESET_TEMP_USER_PASSWORD}/${idKeycloak}/reset-password`,
    resetPasswordBody,
    {
      headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
    }

}

export const getUserInfoNubo = (email: string, token: string) => {
  return httpUserManagment.get(`${API_ROUTES.FIND_USER}?userName=${email}`, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
  })
}

export const updateUser = (
  email: string,
  token: string,
  userId: number,
  body: Record<string, any>
) => {
  return httpUserManagment.patch(`${API_ROUTES.MANAGE_USER}/${userId}`, body, {
    headers: buildStandardHeaders(email, token)
  })
}

```

## src/features/auth/utils/getMessageError.ts

```typescript
import {
  ERROR_CODES,
  ERROR_MESSAGES,
  HTTP_CODES
} from '@/shared/constants/auth'

export const getMessageError = ({
  errorCode,
  httpCode
}: {
  errorCode?: string
  httpCode?: string
}) => {
  let message

  if (
    errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_NOT_FOUND ||
    httpCode === HTTP_CODES.UNAUTHORIZED
  ) {
    message = ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_NOT_FOUND
  } else if (errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_BLOCKED) {
    message = ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_BLOCKED
  } else if (errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_INACTIVE) {
    message = ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_INACTIVE
  } else if (errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_SUSPENDED) {
    message = ERROR_MESSAGES.USER_SUSPENDED
  } else if (errorCode === ERROR_CODES.USER_BLOCKED_EXCEEDS_FAILED_ATTEMPTS) {
    message = ERROR_MESSAGES.BLOCKED_ACCOUNT
  } else if (
    httpCode &&
    parseInt(httpCode) >= parseInt(HTTP_CODES.SERVER_ERROR)
  ) {
    message = ERROR_MESSAGES.SERVER_ERROR
  }
  return message
}

```

## src/features/auth/utils/passwordHandlers.ts

```typescript
import { NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES } from '@/features/auth/constants/changePassword'
import { InfoModal } from '@/features/auth/types/newPassword'

interface HandlePasswordResponseParams {
  response: string
  setOpenModal: (open: boolean) => void
  setInfoModal: (modal: InfoModal) => void
  setUpdatePassword: (value: boolean) => void
  onSuccess: () => void
}

export const handlePasswordResponse = ({
  response,
  setOpenModal,
  setInfoModal,
  setUpdatePassword,
  onSuccess
}: HandlePasswordResponseParams) => {
  const modalProps: Record<string, InfoModal> = {
    success: {
      title: NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.SUCCESS_TITLE,
      message: NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.SUCCESS_MESSAGE,
      textSuccess: 'Entendido',
      onClick: () => {
        setUpdatePassword(false)
        setOpenModal(false)
        onSuccess()
      }
    },
    error: {
      title: NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.GENERIC_ERROR_TITLE,
      message: NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.GENERIC_ERROR_MESSAGE,
      textSuccess: 'Reintentar',
      variant: 'error',
      onClick: () => setOpenModal(false)
    },
    invalid: {
      title: NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.REUSED_PASSWORD_TITLE,
      message: NEW_PASSWORD_MESSAGES.REUSED_PASSWORD_MESSAGE,
      textSuccess: 'Reintentar',
      variant: 'error',
      onClick: () => setOpenModal(false)
    }
  }

  setInfoModal(modalProps[response])
  setOpenModal(true)
}

```

## src/features/auth/utils/passwordValidators.ts

```typescript
export const hasMinLength = (value: string, min: number): boolean =>
  value.length >= min

export const hasMinUppercase = (value: string, min: number): boolean =>
  (value.match(/[A-Z]/g) || []).length >= min

export const hasMinLowercase = (value: string, min: number): boolean =>
  (value.match(/[a-z]/g) || []).length >= min

export const hasMinNumbers = (value: string, min: number): boolean =>
  (value.match(/[0-9]/g) || []).length >= min

export const hasMinSpecialChars = (value: string, min: number): boolean =>
  (value.match(/[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>[\]\\\/\-+=_;']/g) || []).length >= min

export const hasNoConsecutiveCharacters = (value: string): boolean =>
  !/(.)\1/.test(value)

export const hasNoSequentialCharacters = (value: string): boolean => {
  const sequentialPatterns = [
    'abc',
    'bcd',
    'cde',
    'def',
    'efg',
    'fgh',
    'ghi',
    'hij',
    'ijk',
    'jkl',
    'klm',
    'lmn',
    'mno',
    'nop',
    'opq',
    'pqr',
    'qrs',
    'rst',
    'stu',
    'tuv',
    'uvw',
    'vwx',
    'wxy',
    'xyz',
    '012',
    '123',
    '234',
    '345',
    '456',
    '567',
    '678',
    '789'
  ]
  return !sequentialPatterns.some((pattern) =>
    value.toLowerCase().includes(pattern)
  )
}

```

## src/features/auth/utils/userStatusValidator.ts

```typescript
import { onError, onMessageError } from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-authSlice'

import { ERROR_CODES, HTTP_CODES } from '@/shared/constants/auth'

type UserStatus = 'INACTIVE' | 'SUSPENDED' | 'BLOCKED'

const ERROR_STATUS_USER_UNABLE: Record<
  UserStatus,
  { message: string; action: (dispatch: any) => void }
> = {
  INACTIVE: {
    message: 'Usuario inactivoennjedd ',
    action: (dispatch: any) => {
      dispatch(
        onMessageError(
          'Usuario inactivo, por favor comunícate con el administrador de tu entidad.'
        )
      )
      dispatch(onError(true))
    }
  },
  SUSPENDED: {
    message: 'Usuario suspendido',
    action: (dispatch: any) => {
      dispatch(
        onMessageError(
          'Usuario suspendido, por favor comunícate con el administrador de tu entidad.'
        )
      )
      dispatch(onError(true))
    }
  },
  BLOCKED: {
    message: 'Usuario bloqueado',
    action: (dispatch: any) => {
      dispatch(
        onMessageError(
          'Has superado el límite de intentos para inicio de sesión, por favor comunícate con el administrador de tu entidad.'
        )
      )
      dispatch(onError(true))
    }
  }
}

function mapHttpCodeToUserStatus(httpCode: string): UserStatus | null {
  switch (httpCode) {
    case HTTP_CODES.INACTIVE:
      return 'INACTIVE'
    case HTTP_CODES.SUSPENDED:
      return 'SUSPENDED'
    case HTTP_CODES.BLOCKED_ATTEMPTS:
      return 'BLOCKED'
    default:
      return null
  }
}

export function isUserStatusError(errorCode: string): boolean {
  return [
    ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_BLOCKED,
    ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_INACTIVE,
    ERROR_CODES.USER_STATUS_SUSPENDED
  ].includes(errorCode)
}

export function handleUserUnable(httpCode: string, dispatch: any): boolean {
  const userStatus = mapHttpCodeToUserStatus(httpCode)

  if (!userStatus || !ERROR_STATUS_USER_UNABLE[userStatus]) {
    return false
  }

  ERROR_STATUS_USER_UNABLE[userStatus].action(dispatch)
  return true
}

```

```typescript
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    subRoutes: { LOGIN }

  auth: {
    clientId: `${import.meta.env.VITE_CLIENT_ID_MICROSOFT}`, // Tu Client ID
    authority: MICROSOFT_AUTHORITY, // Tu Tenant ID

    redirectUri: `${import.meta.env.VITE_REDIRECT_URI}${LOGIN.path}`,
    postLogoutRedirectUri: `${import.meta.env.VITE_REDIRECT_URI}${LOGIN.path}`, // URI de redirección después de cerrar sesión
    navigateToLoginRequestUrl: false
  },
  cache: {
    cacheLocation: 'sessionStorage',
    storeAuthStateInCookie: false
  },
  system: {
    loggerOptions: {
      loggerCallback(logLevel: any, _message: string, containsPii: boolean) {
        if (containsPii) {
          return
        }
        switch (logLevel) {
          case LogLevel.Error:
            // console.error(message);
            return
          case LogLevel.Info:
            // console.info(message);
            return
          case LogLevel.Verbose:
            // console.debug(message);
            return
          case LogLevel.Warning:
            // console.warn(message);
            return
          default:
            return
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

  scopes: ['User.Read']
}
```

## src/shared/hooks/useIsMobileOrTablet.ts

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 960

export const useIsMobileOrTablet = (): boolean => {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT}px)`)
    const handleResize = (event: MediaQueryListEvent) =>
      setIsMobile(event.matches)

    setIsMobile(mediaQuery.matches)
    // TODO: Check this Prisma Vulnerability
    mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleResize)
    return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleResize)
  }, [])

  return isMobile
}

```

## src/shared/routes/AppRouter.tsx

```tsx
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { Spinner } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ROUTES } from '@/shared/routes'

const Login = lazy(() => import('@/features/auth/pages/Login'))
const Logout = lazy(() => import('@/features/auth/pages/Logout'))
const ChangePassword = lazy(
  () => import('@/features/auth/pages/ChangePassword')
)
const ConfigTwoFactorAuth = lazy(
  () => import('@/features/auth/pages/ConfigTwoFactorAuth')
)
const TwoFactor = lazy(() => import('@/features/auth/pages/TwoFactor'))
const SelectParticipant = lazy(
  () => import('@/features/auth/pages/SelectParticipant')
)

const AppRouter = () => {
  const { isOtpIn, firstLogin, isSelectParticipant } = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) => state.auth
  )

  const {
    AUTHENTICATION: {
      subRoutes: {
        LOGIN,
        NEW_PASSWORD,
        TWO_FA,
        CONFIG_TWO_FA,
        LANDING,
        SELECT_PARTICIPANT
      }
    }
  } = ROUTES

  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route
        path={LOGIN.pathMain}
        element={
          <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
            <Login />
          </Suspense>
        }
      />
      <Route
        path={NEW_PASSWORD.pathMain!}
        element={
          firstLogin ? (
            <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
              <ChangePassword />
            </Suspense>
          ) : (
            <Navigate to={LOGIN.path} />
          )
        }
      />
      <Route
        path={LANDING.pathMain!}
        element={
          firstLogin ? (
            <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
              <Logout />
            </Suspense>
          ) : (
            <Navigate to={LOGIN.path} />
          )
        }
      />
      <Route
        path={CONFIG_TWO_FA.pathMain!}
        element={
          isOtpIn ? (
            <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
              <ConfigTwoFactorAuth />
            </Suspense>
          ) : (
            <Navigate to={LOGIN.path} />
          )
        }
      />
      <Route
        path={TWO_FA.pathMain!}
        element={
          isOtpIn ? (
            <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
              <TwoFactor />
            </Suspense>
          ) : (
            <Navigate to={LOGIN.path} />
          )
        }
      />
      <Route
        path={SELECT_PARTICIPANT.pathMain!}
        element={
          isSelectParticipant ? (
            <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
              <SelectParticipant />
            </Suspense>
          ) : (
            <Navigate to={LOGIN.path} />
          )
        }
      />
      <Route
        path={SELECT_PARTICIPANT.pathMain!}
        element={
          isSelectParticipant ? (
            <Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}>
              <SelectParticipant />
            </Suspense>
          ) : (
            <Navigate to={LOGIN.path} />
          )
        }
      />
    </Routes>
  )
}

export default AppRouter

```

```typescript
export const ROUTES: RouteModule = {
  AUTHENTICATION: {
    path: '/authentication',

    subRoutes: {
      LOGIN: {
```

```typescript
  ...(userEmail && { client_user: userEmail.toLowerCase() }),
```

## src/shared/utils/getDecodedEmailFromURL.ts

```typescript
export const getDecodedEmailFromURL = (paramKey: string): string => {
  const queryParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
  const encodedEmail = queryParams.get(paramKey) || ''
  return atob(encodedEmail)
}

```

## src/shared/utils/headerServices.ts

```typescript
import getCurrentDateTime from './getCurrentDateTime'

export const buildStandardHeaders = (username: string, token?: string) => {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    client_datetime: getCurrentDateTime(),
    client_user: username.toLowerCase()
  }

  if (token) {
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
  }

  return headers
}

export const buildCustomHeaders = (
  additionalHeaders: Record<string, string>
) => ({
  client_datetime: getCurrentDateTime(),
  ...additionalHeaders
})

```

## src/shared/utils/safeCompare.ts

```typescript
import { timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'

export function isPreviousSession(value: unknown) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return false
  const bufferA = Buffer.from(value)
  const bufferB = Buffer.from('true') // o el valor esperado real
  return bufferA.length === bufferB.length && timingSafeEqual(bufferA, bufferB)
}

```

## vite.config.ts

```typescript
import federation from '@originjs/vite-plugin-federation'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react-swc'
import path from 'path'
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from 'vite'
import viteCompression from 'vite-plugin-compression'

import packageJson from './package.json'

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const env = loadEnv(mode, process.cwd(), '')
  return {
    plugins: [
      react(),
      federation({
        name: 'remote-login',
        filename: 'remoteEntry.js',
        remotes: {
          remoteUtilities: env.VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES,
          remoteShell: env.VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
        },
        exposes: {
          './mf-login': './src/App.tsx'
        },
        shared: packageJson.dependencies
      }),
      // ====================================
      // PRE-COMPRESIÓN GZIP
      // ====================================
      viteCompression({
        verbose: true, // Log de archivos comprimidos
        disable: false,
        threshold: 10240, // Solo comprimir archivos > 10KB
        algorithm: 'gzip',
        ext: '.gz',
        deleteOriginFile: false // Mantener archivo original
      })
    ],
    resolve: {
      alias: {
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src')
      }
    },
    build: {
      modulePreload: false,
      target: 'esnext',
      minify: false,
      cssCodeSplit: false
    }
  }
})

```
